title: Design System: YW Coach Admin Operate

label.purpose: Controls, metadata, disclosures, and status labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action on the current surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #B8FF4D; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; color: #06110F; background: #B8FF4D; font: 650 13px/1.4 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #C8FF72; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,245,197,.45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #A7EB3E; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded alternative action that does not compete with the primary decision.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.28); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #0D211A; font: 650 13px/1.4 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(51,245,197,.58); background: #102719; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,245,197,.38); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background: #0A1714; }

components.name: Admin Text Input
components.description: A compact field for search, commands, filters, and operational data.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #F4FFF0; font: 650 13px/1.4 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.22); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 12px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #06110F; font: 500 14px/1.5 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8EA19A; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(184,255,77,.4); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #33F5C5; outline: 3px solid rgba(51,245,197,.22); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Verified Status Chip
components.description: A text-backed compact state indicator for verified or current status.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 30px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.38); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 10px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #0D211A; font: 650 13px/1 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #B8FF4D; }

components.name: Operational Surface
components.description: A flat, bounded working area for data, evidence, or state.
components.html:
Operational signal

No coach-site signal is available yet.
components.css: .ds-surface { display: grid; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.16); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #0D211A; } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 16px/1.3 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface p { margin: 0; max-width: 65ch; color: #8EA19A; font: 500 14px/1.5 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Progressive Disclosure
components.description: Keeps secondary commands and technical detail available without competing with the next decision.
components.html:
More commandsAll approved actions remain available+
Permission-filtered commands
components.css: .ds-disclosure { overflow: clip; border: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.16); border-radius: 12px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #0D211A; } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary > span:first-child { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-disclosure strong { font: 650 13px/1.4 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure small { color: #8EA19A; font: 500 12px/1.4 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { background: #102719; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,245,197,.38); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-disclosure-body { border-top: 1px solid rgba(184,255,77,.16); padding: 14px; color: #8EA19A; }

components.name: Admin AI Trigger
components.description: A restrained entry to contextual assistance, not a decorative mascot stage.
components.css: .ds-ai-trigger { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0,1fr); min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(51,245,197,.34); border-radius: 12px; padding: 5px 9px 5px 5px; color: #F4FFF0; background: #0D211A; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ai-mark { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(51,245,197,.3); border-radius: 10px; color: #06110F; background: #B8FF4D; font: 800 12px/1 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ai-trigger > span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-ai-trigger strong { font: 700 13px/1.25 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ai-trigger small { overflow: hidden; color: #8EA19A; font: 500 12px/1.25 Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ai-trigger:hover { border-color: rgba(51,245,197,.58); background: #102719; } .ds-ai-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,245,197,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
YW Coach Admin feels like a calm operations room in active use: dense enough for real work, quiet enough to scan under pressure, and explicit about which signals are current, missing, blocked, or actionable. The dark theme uses deep green-black tonal layers with a rare high-energy lime action voice; the light theme is a true structural counterpart with pale green canvases, near-white working surfaces, and deep green ink.

The system rejects generic AI-tool theater, marketing-dashboard composition, fake production data, and any visual wrapper that hides legacy Admin UI. Repeated operational detail is progressively disclosed. AI remains a contextual instrument inside the product rather than the product's visual protagonist.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-first hierarchy with the next decision visible.
Restrained semantic color and flat-by-default surfaces.
Compact, familiar controls with complete interaction states.
Permission-aware navigation and honest empty, blocked, and failure states.
Responsive structural changes without ornamental choreography.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Verified Lime is rare: use it for the current choice, the primary action, or a verified live signal—not for decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light mode must express the same hierarchy with its own canvas, surface, border, text, map, and state treatments; it must never look like a translucent skin over dark mode.

rules.name: The Semantic Restraint Rule
rules.body: Danger, warning, success, and information colors communicate state. Never use them as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels explain tasks; do not turn every section into tracked uppercase scaffolding.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Exact Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the content benefits from character-level comparison or exact reference.

rules.name: The Compact Scale Rule
rules.body: Product hierarchy stays within a tight fixed scale; fluid marketing typography is prohibited inside Admin.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is part of the normal page flow, it does not need a shadow.

rules.name: The One Depth Signal Rule
rules.body: Use either a boundary or structural shadow for separation; never combine a wide decorative shadow with a routine one-pixel card border.

rules.name: The Blocking-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevated depth belongs to UI that genuinely blocks or floats above the current task.

dos: Do keep the next operator decision visible and place supporting evidence immediately nearby.
Do use Verified Lime (#B8FF4D) for one primary action, active choice, or verified signal at a time.
Do preserve complete loading, empty, blocked, stale, partial, unavailable, success, and failure states.
Do progressively disclose commands, context, technical safeguards, feedback, observability, and duplicate module navigation.
Do keep every module, record, action, and explanation aligned with current RBAC.
Do use one-pixel boundaries, 12px surfaces, 44px touch targets, visible focus, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do keep model recommendations subordinate to deterministic authorization, execution, receipts, and audit history.
donts: Don't present a generic AI chatbot or autonomous-agent spectacle that competes with the operator's task.
Don't build a marketing-style SaaS dashboard from hero metrics, decorative gradients, glass panels, or repeated promotional cards.
Don't present mock, prototype, placeholder, or fabricated production data as real.
Don't mount legacy Admin wrappers, hidden old UI, stale labels, dead controls, or a visual skin that conceals an older interface.
Don't expand every command, context block, recommendation, safeguard, and technical detail at once.
Don't use model output as permission, payment, validation, calculation, OTP, route-protection, or destructive-action authority.
Don't add gradient text, decorative grid overlays, ambient glows, side-stripe accents over 1px, or wide ghost-card shadows to new routine Admin surfaces.
Don't exceed 16px card radii; full pills are reserved for chips and compact controls.
Don't communicate warning, danger, success, selection, or availability through color alone.
